background_image_description: Full-canvas collage split into four photographic quadrants by thick white diagonal bands forming a central white rotated square (diamond). Top-left quadrant: pastel peach-pink backdrop with assorted white cosmetic containers (tubes, jar, dropper bottle) lit with hard shadows. Top-right quadrant: two-tone yellow and orange background with two dark amber glass dropper bottles with gold collars angled toward the center. Bottom-left quadrant: tan and pale cream paper surfaces with a white pump bottle, a white bath bomb, and a lip balm tube casting long shadows. Bottom-right quadrant: gray wall above a white marble surface holding a small light-beige basket with a textured cloth and two small clear bottles filled with pink liquid, black caps. White bands converge to the center, creating a clean white diamond where text sits.
